As Project Systems Lead, you will set up, test and roll out Procore across every country we operate in, then act as the single point of contact for its ongoing support and improvement. You will bring our project information together in one place, connect it with the other systems the business relies on, and build the portfolio data and dashboards our leaders use to make decisions. Sitting within the Development Division, you will support Project Controls and Governance and the PMO. They own the processes and the numbers; you own the system, the data and the automation behind them. Every process, field and approval step should earn its place, data should be entered once, and anything that can sensibly be automated should be. Key Responsibilities Platform ownership Own the Firmus Procore instance end to end, including configuration, permissions, templates, standards and release management. Act as the single point of contact for Procore across the business and the main relationship with Procore's account, support and development teams. Work with Procore to scope, build and test customisations that fit how Firmus delivers projects. Rollout and adoption Plan and lead a country-by-country rollout, starting with Tasmania, Sydney, Melbourne, Malaysia and Indonesia, and extending to new regions as the portfolio grows. Test configurations with project teams before go-live and set clear readiness criteria for each rollout. Design and deliver practical training for in-country teams, on site and remotely, and build a network of local champions. Bringing project information together Map the project information currently held in SharePoint, Aconex and separate systems, and agree what moves, what is archived and what stays. Migrate projects one at a time, timed around key dates so live projects are not disrupted. Keep any interim integrations simple, each with an agreed end date, and close old SharePoint and Aconex project workspaces once they are no longer needed. Integrations Lead the integration of Procore with NetSuite (finance) and Procurify (procurement) so commitments, costs, invoices and payments flow without re-entry. Over time, assess links to contractor-used platforms such as CxAlloy (commissioning and quality) and HammerTech (site safety and contractor management), so Firmus receives contractor data without anyone entering it twice. Portfolio data and reporting Build and maintain centralised , portfolio-level data and dashboards covering schedule, cost, risk and contract status. Automate the monthly portfolio reporting pack from a single data source. Make the handover from project data to executive reporting reliable and traceable, supporting the weekly Portfolio Controls Group, monthly Executive Portfolio Review, stage-gate reviews and Board reporting. Replace manual status updates with live dashboards wherever possible, so meetings can focus on decisions. Financial controls support Support Project Managers, the PMO and Finance with budget, commitment and change tracking, AP/AR visibility and cashflow forecasting in Procore. Help ensure every active project is baselined and reconciled to contracted customer dates. Skills & Experience Hands-on experience as a Procore administrator, product owner or platform lead, ideally across multiple projects or regions.
